subject.title: Add Model and Token Usage Status Display to Control UI Topbar

question: Should model and usage status be persistent across every Control UI tab, or should the existing chat controls be extended with session context usage while provider quota remains linked to the Usage page?
rationale: Current main has adjacent but semantically different surfaces, and source evidence cannot decide the intended meaning of “token usage,” the correct scope outside chat, or the acceptable topbar density.

options.title: Extend Chat Status
options.body: Add effective model and session context usage to the existing responsive chat controls while retaining the provider quota pill and Usage-page billing details.

options.title: Add Global Topbar Status
options.body: Make model and usage status persistent across all tabs, defining which active session supplies the values and how stale or absent state is represented.

options.title: Decline Persistent Status
options.body: Keep model, provider quota, and detailed usage on their existing chat and Usage surfaces and close the placement request as not planned.

recommendation.title: Extend Chat Status
recommendation.body: Add effective model and session context usage to the existing responsive chat controls while retaining the provider quota pill and Usage-page billing details.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest combined history covers provider quota semantics, Control UI chat/sidebar behavior, and the existing product-placement review.
